top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock to Katori and Ye is a distinct invention (magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms), independently reproduced by several laboratories at the 1e-18 level, with a clean two-name allocation and a citation of invention and development that stays clear of the 2005 and 2012 prizes. It is mature enough that waiting for the redefinition of the second gains nothing, so I prefer it to no award.
